chunks: Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who accepts Islam for the sake of inheritance, he said: “If it has been divided, then he has no right to it; but if it has not been divided, then the inheritance belongs to him.”
He said: I said, “A slave who is freed for the sake of inheritance?” So he said: “He is in the same position.”

key_terms.الْمِيرَاثِ: inheritance; the estate left by the deceased
key_terms.بِمَنْزِلَتِهِ: in the same legal position or ruling
key_terms.قُسِمَ: was divided or distributed among the heirs

ai.seo_question: Does a person who accepts Islam, or a slave who is freed, inherit if the estate has not yet been divided?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about inheritance for one who embraces Islam, and similarly for a slave who is freed, before the estate is distributed. If the inheritance has already been divided, no share remains for him; if it has not yet been divided, he is entitled to inherit.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5700 - Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Aban ibn Uthman from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Abdullah (as) regarding a man who accepts Islam for the sake of inheritance.
Imam (as) said: "If the inheritance has already been divided, then he has no right to it. But if it has not been divided, then he is entitled to the inheritance."

I asked: "What about a slave who is freed for the sake of inheritance?"
Imam (as) said: "He is in the same position."
